title: The Sun on the Wall
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: A true fact book: a sunny rock really does warm up, which is exactly why so many small creatures like to share one on a sunny day.

pages.illustration: A big bright sun rising over a garden wall top at the start of the day.

pages.text: The sun got on a rock.
pages.illustration: A flat grey rock on the wall top, sunlight now falling directly on it.
Moss the hedgehog climbing up onto the sunny flat rock.
Fig the caterpillar also settling onto the same sunny rock, next to Moss.
Pip the sparrow landing on the rock too, now three friends sharing the warm spot.

pages.text: Moss, Fig and Pip sat in the sun.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog, Fig the caterpillar and Pip the sparrow all sitting together on the rock, soaking up the sunshine.

pages.text: The rock got the sun. Moss, Fig and Pip got the sun.
pages.illustration: Wide view of the warm wall top in full sunshine, the rock and all three friends glowing in the light.
